description: Use deliberate gripper pulses to place stable dice. Clamp each while its top face is level and the seal ring is full. The captured top faces must add to the displayed target. Nothing changes while you decide. A bad clamp or incomplete certification ends the attempt.
name: Top-Face Dice Arithmetic V2 · Action-Stepped Counterpart · Difficulty 5 · Simplified Interaction
